subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Airlines
overview: Fly Juneyao Airlines to Shanghai, then visit Wuxi’s Nianhua Bay (the “Mini Kyoto” of China), Nanxun Ancient Town and West Lake in Hangzhou before returning to Shanghai for the Bund and Starbucks Flagship store. You stay in 4-star hotels, enjoy a free upgrade to a BBQ lunch and a Yuyuan hotpot lunch, and have a free day in Shanghai, with Shanghai Disneyland available as an optional tour.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Oct 27–31 2026 to Mar 19–23 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Nanjing Road Walking Street: Shanghai's best-known pedestrian shopping street, lined with shops and neon signs.
placeDesc.The Bund: A historic waterfront promenade along the Huangpu River with colonial-era buildings and a skyline view.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Nianhua Bay: A Japanese-style lakeside scenic area in Wuxi, nicknamed the Mini Kyoto of China, seen at night.
placeDesc.Nanxun Ancient Town: A canal town in Zhejiang with old merchant houses and stone bridges, visited with a boat ride included.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous freshwater lake, a UNESCO World Heritage site, enjoyed on a stroll.
placeDesc.West Lake New World: A lakeside leisure district in Hangzhou for evening strolling and dining.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Garden: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou where guests can try a Hanfu costume experience.
placeDesc.Starbucks Flagship store: A large Starbucks flagship store in Shanghai, visited as a city-tour stop.
placeDesc.LV mega ship: A ship-shaped Louis Vuitton building in Shanghai, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Zhang Garden: A historic garden in Shanghai, visited as a sightseeing stop on the way back to the city.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: The City God Temple in Shanghai's old town, surrounded by a busy market and shopping area.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: Shanghai's Disney resort, offered as an optional full-day tour on the free day.
placeDesc.Jinmao Tower: A skyscraper in Pudong whose 88th-floor sightseeing hall is part of an optional tour.
placeDesc.Xintiandi: A Shanghai district of restored stone-gate houses converted into cafes, shops and restaurants.
